mapper.sql: select customer_org_id, customer_code, customer_name, contact_name, contact_phone, address, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from oc_customer_org
mapper.select:
del_flag = '0'
and customer_code like concat('%', #{customerCode}, '%')
and customer_name like concat('%', #{customerName}, '%')
and contact_name like concat('%', #{contactName}, '%')
and contact_phone like concat('%', #{contactPhone}, '%')
and status = #{status}
order by customer_name, customer_org_id
where del_flag = '0' and status = '0' order by customer_name, customer_org_id
mapper.update: update oc_customer_org set customer_code = #{customerCode}, customer_name = #{customerName}, contact_name = #{contactName}, contact_phone = #{contactPhone}, address = #{address}, status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), remark = #{remark} where customer_org_id = #{customerOrgId} and del_flag = '0'
